easy: Money you pay to do something or to get help from someone.

easy: Feeling sad or upset because someone was unkind to you.

ex.ko: 미아는 친구가 그림을 보고 웃자 기분이 상했다.

easy: To close something with a key so no one can open it.

ex.ko: 우리 강아지가 젖은 코를 내 손에 갖다 댔다.

ex.ko: 아빠는 내 학교 음악회에 파란 넥타이를 매고 오셨다.

easy: One time each month.

easy: Used after a year that was long ago, before year 1.

ex.ko: 대피라미드는 기원전 2500년경에 지어졌다.

easy: Very big, covering a lot of space.

easy: Close to right but not exact.

ex.en: Give me a rough guess of how many marbles are in the jar.
ex.ko: 병 속에 구슬이 몇 개 있는지 대략 짐작해 봐.

easy: What you notice when you breathe in through your nose.

ex.en: I love the smell of fresh bread.
ex.ko: 나는 갓 구운 빵 냄새를 좋아한다.

easy: What your nose notices about something.

ex.en: The smell of the garbage can was awful.
ex.ko: 쓰레기통 냄새가 끔찍했다.

easy: That people are looking for.

ex.en: The long sought treasure was found under the old tree.
ex.ko: 오랫동안 찾던 보물이 늙은 나무 밑에서 발견되었다.

easy: A person who talks to a group of people.

ex.en: The speaker at our assembly was an astronaut.
ex.ko: 우리 조회 시간의 연사는 우주비행사였다.

easy: A box that makes music or voices loud enough to hear.

ex.en: The music was too loud from the speaker.
ex.ko: 스피커에서 나오는 음악이 너무 컸다.
